extraction.Name: Enoch W. Raymond, Jr.
extraction.Refused/Protested: No. Were you satisfied with the sale? Yes at the time I was but I think the patent should not have been forced upon me.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I first mortgaged and then sold
extraction.NOTES: Eight dependents; patent sent to him by mail in June 1920; did not remember signing a receipt for the patent; received $4000.00 in cash for the land; document reference CLll 7/24,94044; notarized May 9, 1929 by Chas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32; allotment also referenced as 2285
